articles.title: Braiins warns of Bitcoin mining attacks affecting over 1,000 sites
articles.snippet: Bitcoin mining pool operator Braiins warned that attackers are exploiting unsecured connections to hijack miners’ computing power and potentially steal rewards.

articles.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
articles.snippet: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.

articles.title: Hackers breach CIA intelligence network in latest US cyberattack
articles.snippet: The reported breach follows cyber incidents involving the FBI, Department of Homeland Security and Department of Agriculture.

articles.title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
articles.snippet: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.

articles.title: Another Bitcoin Mining Firm Flags 'Hashrate Hijacking' Attacks That Reroute Rewards
articles.snippet: Braiins says an attacker exploited the unencrypted Stratum V1 protocol and internet route hijacking to impersonate mining pools, striking over 1,000 sites in a single second.
